description: This PHP class 'TimesheetPeriodService' provides methods to manage and retrieve timesheet period configurations, including fetching defined periods, setting new periods, and retrieving headings and start dates within the context of a human resource management system.

classes.name: TimesheetPeriodService
classes.description: Service class for managing timesheet periods, including retrieval, configuration, and validation of period settings.

methods.name: getDefinedTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the configured timesheet period data for the current date.

methods.name: getDaysOfTheTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Calculates the number of days in the timesheet period based on the XML configuration and current date.

methods.name: isTimesheetPeriodDefined
methods.description: Checks if the timesheet period has been defined in configuration.

methods.name: setTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Sets a new timesheet period starting date and updates configuration accordingly.

methods.name: getTimesheetHeading
methods.description: Retrieves the heading/title for the current timesheet period from configuration XML.

methods.name: getTimesheetStartDate
methods.description: Retrieves the start date of the current timesheet period from configuration XML.
